pages.title: Wear the Night
pages.text: Player-killed Phantoms have a 10% chance to drop one Crescent Moon. Looting does not increase this chance.
Worn: grants Night Vision, Speed and Jump Boost at night.$(br2)Forge: base Aureal requirements become 90% by day and 99% at night.$(br2)On a jar: slowly produces Aureal.
pages.title: Crescent Moon
